items.question: In which year did the UAE begin its fuel price deregulation policy for gasoline and diesel?
items.fact: UAE fuel price deregulation started August 2015 for gasoline and diesel.

items.question: How often are gasoline and diesel prices reviewed in the UAE under the fuel price deregulation policy?
items.gold: Monthly, by the Gasoline and Diesel Prices Follow-up Committee.
items.fact: Gasoline and diesel prices are reviewed monthly by a committee.
